title: EnumRegistry
description: Canonical enumeration values used across APIs, events, database columns, and clients. This is the single source of truth for every status/enum string in the platform — no other artifact may define a competing value set for the same concept. See docs/architecture/22-canonical-entities-and-enums.md.

meaning.suspended: Access blocked by an admin action; data retained; reversible.
meaning.deleted: User-initiated or admin-initiated deletion cascade has run; terminal.

meaning.active: Refresh token valid and not revoked.
meaning.revoked: Explicitly invalidated (logout, reuse-detection, admin, password reset).
meaning.expired: Passed its absolute or sliding TTL without being explicitly revoked.

meaning.moderated_hidden: Hidden from public read/search by moderation decision; retained.

meaning.approved: Moderator/admin approved; Places has applied or is applying the mutation.
meaning.rejected: Moderator/admin rejected; no canonical mutation applied.
meaning.withdrawn: Submitter withdrew before a decision was made.

meaning.hidden: Hidden by moderation decision; retained for audit.
meaning.deleted: Removed by its own author; tombstoned, not purged.

meaning.requested: Pre-signed upload URL issued, binary not yet received.
meaning.uploading: Client is transferring the binary to object storage (transient, not always observed server-side).
meaning.uploaded: Object storage confirms the binary landed; awaiting validation.
meaning.processing: Passed scanning; derivative generation in progress.
meaning.ready: Derivatives generated and published; visible per its context's visibility rules.
meaning.rejected: Failed validation, scanning, or structural checks; binary deleted.
meaning.removed: Removed by uploader or moderation after having been ready; binary scheduled for deletion.

meaning.paused: No location update within the grace period; state preserved for resumption.
meaning.rerouting: Sustained off-route detected; new route being computed.
meaning.cancelled: User or system cancelled before arrival; terminal.
meaning.expired: Paused beyond the outer resumption window without resuming; terminal.

meaning.computed: One or more routes returned successfully.
meaning.no_route_found: Request was well-formed; no viable route exists for the constraints.
meaning.failed: Routing engine or dependency failure prevented computation.

meaning.transit: Public transit routing (requires transit data source).

meaning.free: At or near free-flow reference speed.

meaning.resolved: Confirmed cleared (by source update or expiry of estimated duration).
meaning.expired: No confirming update received before an internal staleness ceiling; treated as resolved for routing purposes but tagged distinctly for audit.

meaning.pending: Queued, not yet attempted or awaiting retry.
meaning.suppressed: Not attempted because the user's preference opted the channel/category out.

meaning.active: A worker is currently processing it.
meaning.failed: A single attempt failed; will retry if attempts remain.
meaning.dead_lettered: Exhausted max attempts; moved to the DLQ topic/table.

meaning.request_more_info: Returned to the submitter/reporter for clarification; case stays open.

meaning.received: Raw snapshot ingested, not yet processed.
meaning.rejected: Failed the quality gate; previous published version remains authoritative.
meaning.building: Derived-product builds (search index, tiles, routing graph) in progress.
meaning.published: Live as the current authoritative version.
meaning.superseded: A later version has since been published; retained for rollback window.
meaning.rolled_back: Was published, then explicitly reverted from due to a discovered issue.
